entries.title: Ling 3.1 Flash
entries.summary: inclusionAI's Ling 3.1 Flash joins the catalog: a hybrid reasoning mixture-of-experts model with 25B active of 560B total parameters, a 262,144-token context window, and tool calling, available through BYOK.

entries.title: Gemma 3 4B IT
entries.summary: Google's Gemma 3 4B IT joins the catalog: a 4B open-weight instruct model with text and image input, a 131,072-token context window, and multilingual coverage across 140+ languages, available through BYOK.
